subject: Venue check-in -> leadflow mapping & consent language
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@conveneevents.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite badge scanners + lead handoff details

Hi Ben and Laura,

Thanks for confirming Redwood as our platinum sponsor for Pacific Tech Summit. A couple of logistical items from our side around lead capture at registration and on the expo floor:

- We have two badge-scanner partners on site (ScanTech and QuickScan). ScanTech is providing Bluetooth handhelds that can export batched CSV every 30 minutes; QuickScan offers a persistent websocket push to a vendor endpoint.
- Venue staff can add a short consent snippet during badge printing if you want opt-in explicitly recorded on the badge file.
- We can provide an API/webhook for near-real-time pushes but will need a contact for handshake/whitelisting.

I've attached our badge spec and a sample CSV. Can your team confirm: 1) which ingest mode you prefer (batched CSV vs webhook), 2) HubSpot field mapping, and 3) the canonical consent text we should print?

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Event Operations Manager, Convene Events
attachments: convene_badges_spec_v1.pdf, sample-batch.csv
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@conveneevents.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite badge scanners + lead handoff details

Hi Samantha — thanks, this is helpful. Quick answers and proposed next steps:

1) Ingest mode: We prefer the webhook (near-real-time) from ScanTech if they can push to a whitelisted endpoint. If not, the 30-minute CSV batch is fine, but we'll lose short-lived session attribution.
2) HubSpot vs SFDC: for this event we're pushing directly to HubSpot. I've attached a short CSV template and mapping we use for expo leads. Key fields we need: first_name, last_name, email, company, job_title, source=Pacific Tech Summit, opt_in=true/false.
3) Consent language: we need a checkbox-equivalent consent line captured at check-in. Suggested minimal text (so it will fit on a badge receipt): "I agree to be contacted by Redwood Inference about relevant products and events."

Next steps:
- Aaron Patel at ScanTech (copied by Samantha below) to confirm webhook details and TLS requirements.
- Diego, can you validate the CSV -> HubSpot ingestion pipeline and any delay/duplication concerns?
- Marissa, please draft a short thank-you email to attendees that ties to the opt-in so we can demonstrate double opt-in where required.

I'll schedule a 30-minute tech handoff tomorrow if that works for everyone.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@conveneevents.com>, Aaron Patel <aaron@scantech.io>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite badge scanners + lead handoff details

Thanks — adding some technical constraints and proposals from the ingestion side:

- Webhook option: we can host a short-lived public endpoint with mTLS + IP allowlist provided by Convene. Payload expected: JSON with base fields (fn, ln, email, company, title, timestamp, consent_flag, badge_id). We will accept a 200/202 ack and retry policy.
- CSV batch option: we can process files dropped to a secure SFTP or an encrypted email attachment every 15–30 minutes. We will parse by badge_id and dedupe on email + badge_id within a 24-hour sliding window.
- Mapping quirks: Sometimes scanners send country codes or phone in different columns; please ask ScanTech to include a consistent header row. We'll use the attached hubspot-field-mapping-template.csv for onboarding.
- Consent: store a verbatim consent_snippet in a custom HubSpot property (lead.consent_text) and a boolean (lead.opt_in). For privacy regs (EU attendees), we'll also capture consent_source=badge_receipt or onsite_form.

Attachment: consent-snippet-v3.txt (suggested shortened text for badge receipts and a longer variant for post-event emails).

Action items for Convene/Aaron: share a test webhook URL and sample JSON payload, or a nightly sample CSV so we can validate ingestion.

—Diego
Diego Fernandez
Integrations Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@conveneevents.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite badge scanners + lead handoff details

Quick operational checklist and timing from marketing:

- Onsite tags: please append source:PACIFIC_TECH_SUMMIT and session_tag where available so we can segment follow-ups.
- Email flow: 1) immediate thank-you (if opt_in == true) within 6 hours, 2) nurture sequence start at day 3.
- Compliance: For EU contacts, route to our EU data pipeline (diego, flag consent_source=onsite_form).
- Reporting: We need a daily CSV export of all processed leads through HubSpot for reconciliation with Convene's attendee list.

Ben — I'll own the post-event email content and the opt-in copy in both short and long forms. Attached legal-approved consent snippet (consent-snippet-v3.txt).

Marissa Cole
Demand Gen Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@conveneevents.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Patel <aaron@scantech.io>, eventsops@conveneevents.com
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite badge scanners + lead handoff details

Perfect — thanks everyone. Aaron confirmed ScanTech can do a webhook to a whitelisted IP + TLS 1.2. Attached a small sample payload and our vendor onboarding form.

Commitments from Convene:
- Whitelisted IPs & certs to be provided by Monday EOD (6/29).
- Test pushes from ScanTech on Tuesday 6/30.
- Onsite staff will print the short consent line on the badge receipt as agreed.

Ben/Diego/Marissa: if you can confirm the webhook URL and provide a single testing window (30 min) on 6/30 we'll sign off.

Samantha
